title: Maintainability
description: Practices for code that stays comprehensible.

practices.title: Names state intent
practices.statement: Names state intent; a reader should not need the body to understand the call.

practices.title: One responsibility
practices.statement: Modules and functions do one thing; branching by unrelated concerns splits them.

practices.title: Delete dead code
practices.statement: Delete unused code and abstractions instead of annotating them.

practices.title: Dependency direction
practices.statement: Dependencies point from specific to general; new cycles are defects.

practices.title: Comments explain why
practices.statement: Comments explain why; code explains what.
